assessments.reasoning: The digest-matched Chapter 5 §5.5 describes dynamic instances of a class body and object generation by evaluation. The referenced §3.8.2 places the new class generator under object expressions and §4.7 details creation of a new class body instance.

challenge.method: Check §§3.8.2, 4.7, and 4.10 on generators as expressions and statements, old references, and prefixed blocks for an adverse case to exclusivity.
challenge.results: The generator has the claimed effect in its specified scope. A statement can use the same generator form. Existing object references do not require a new object, and a prefixed block has its own concatenated instance model.

limitations: The documented ordinary object-generator case leaves prefixed blocks and representation or storage particulars out of scope.
